lines.text: CLING to the Bible, if all else be taken;
Lose not it precepts so precious and pure,
Souls that are sleeping its tiding awaken
Life from the dead in its promises sure.
Cling to the Bible (3 times)
Our Lamp and our Guide.
Amen.
Cling to he Bible ‘its jewel and ‘tis treasure
Brings life eternal, and saves fallen man:
Surely its value no mortal, can measure
Seek for its blessing O soul, while you can.
Lamp for the feel that in by ways
have wandered
Guide for the youth that would
other wise fall Hope for the sinner
whose life has been squandered.
Staff for the aged, and Best Book of all.
